limitations: Between-review revisions state no separate exchange-effective date, so they apply from their publication date. The 2016 H1 merger list was published before the period began and replaces the original list for the whole period.

The 2012-2013 workbooks state no publication date. published_at is set to the period start, the latest date by which the list was public, because the index used it from that day. The SET archive offers no between-review update files for 2012-2014, so any replacement inside those periods is not reflected.
Company names for 2014 are in Thai because the 2014 workbooks have Thai sheets only. Sectors are mapped to English with the SET's own summary tables.
Tickers are the symbols printed in each list. Renamed securities (for example KK to KKP, TUF to TU, PS to PSH) appear under each historical symbol and are not linked.
The union file is for price acquisition only. Using it as a static model universe would reintroduce survivorship and future-membership bias.
source: Stock Exchange of Thailand official SET50/SET100 constituent archive
